clips.text: Why does our star keep running away?
Maybe it read your building inspection.
It's two crates. They passed.
Did we ask whether it wanted a tower?
Your home's up there. This gets you closer.
Technically, so would a thick hat.
Have you got a better idea?
The hill. It's already built.
Highest spot around. No assembly required.
Go on. You're nearly... slightly closer.
It's pointing the other way again.
I carried it all this way.
That doesn't make this the right place.
Before we try another rescue... how did you get down?
We never asked that.
I thought falling was fairly self-explanatory.
What were you looking for?
It came down to meet that star.
Its reflection?
You thought someone was down there waiting?
And now it can't find the way back.
We've been solving the wrong problem. Very enthusiastically.
Let's follow where it's pointing this time.
